note: What the kidneys' parts are called when people talk (ArtifactExplorer, artifact_explore isolate). Part names are the GLB's node names; an entry without 'Left'/'Right' covers both sides when 'bilateral' is true. 'aka' are other names for one part; a group's 'words' all mean its parts.

Kidney.about: Filters the blood and makes urine

Renal pelvis.about: The funnel that collects urine inside the kidney

Adrenal gland.about: Sits on the kidney and makes adrenaline and cortisol

Ureter.about: The tube that carries urine down to the bladder

Renal artery.about: Brings blood from the aorta into the kidney

Renal vein.about: Carries filtered blood back to the vena cava

Aorta.about: The body's main artery, feeding the kidneys

Inferior vena cava.about: The great vein that takes blood back to the heart

Urinary bladder.about: Stores urine: about half a litre
